title: Inverse-mate evaluation square for the open scalar comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E to L, n>=0, schemes X and Z, and an open immersion j:X to Z. For every arbitrary unbounded derived E-system N on X, the open extension evaluation for L followed by the normalized scalar evaluation on X equals scalar evaluation on Z, followed by the evaluated inverse open scalar mate, the E open extension evaluation, and the finite open scalar transpose. This is the inverse-mate square before cancellation of the forward system open scalar map; no boundedness, constructibility, flatness or faithfulness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Compute the ordinary inverse mate on the open sequence site. The balanced tensor comparison is identity on generators and extension by zero is zero off the open. Evaluate the units and counits of the two open adjunctions and the normalized scalar adjunction; the universal cochain counits transport the identity to the fixed models. The resulting equation is preserved by localization for arbitrary unbounded systems.

Only generic categorical mate-pasting theorems in Mates.lean. Project searches find semilinearScalarOperations and scalar-model adjunctions, reused in SystemScalarFiniteEvaluation. No proper/open scalar evaluation square for the fixed models. Blueprint searches for scalar evaluation, proper scalar and open scalar find no matching system theorem: the finite compact scalar transport node concerns bounded-below etale-origin inputs.

theorem systemOpenScalarInv_finiteEvaluation_core
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) L]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (n : ℕ) (N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E X) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    let uE :=
      letI := systemOpenEvaluationInv_isIso l E j n
      (asIso (systemOpenEvaluationInv l E j n)).symm
    let uL :=
      letI := systemOpenEvaluationInv_isIso l L j n
      (asIso (systemOpenEvaluationInv l L j n)).symm
    let a :=
      ((mateEquiv (pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction
          (scalarRingMap (integralScalarQuotientMap l E L ι n) X))
        (pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction
          (scalarRingMap (integralScalarQuotientMap l E L ι n) Z))).symm
        (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
          ((Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
            (sfOpenRestriction j (integralScalarQuotientMap l E L ι n))).hom))).natTrans
    (uL.hom.app ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι X).obj N)) ≫
        (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((systemScalarFiniteEvaluation l E L ι X n).hom.app N) =
      (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l L Z n).map
          ((systemOpenScalarInv l E L ι j).app N) ≫
        (systemScalarFiniteEvaluation l E L ι Z n).hom.app
          ((systemDerivedOpen l E j).obj N) ≫
        (pbcDerivedExtend
          (scalarRingMap (integralScalarQuotientMap l E L ι n) Z)).map
          (uE.hom.app N) ≫
        a.app ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).obj N)
